definitions.explanation: Describing behavior, expression, or content that is openly displayed without any attempt to conceal or soften it. Often carries a negative connotation, suggesting something that should be restrained or hidden is being shown too openly.

examples.japanese: {露骨|ろこつ}な{表現|ひょうげん}は{避|さ}けてください。
{彼|かれ}は{露骨|ろこつ}に{嫌|いや}な{顔|かお}をした。
{最近|さいきん}、SNSでの{露骨|ろこつ}な{宣伝|せんでん}が{増|ふ}えていて{不快|ふかい}だ。
examples.english: The blatant advertising on social media has been increasing recently and it's unpleasant.

notes: Used both as a na-adjective ({露骨|ろこつ}な) and as an adverb ({露骨|ろこつ}に). Almost always carries a negative connotation — something is being shown too openly or crudely. Common collocations: {露骨|ろこつ}な{表現|ひょうげん} (explicit expression), {露骨|ろこつ}な{態度|たいど} (undisguised attitude), {露骨|ろこつ}に{嫌|いや}がる (openly show dislike). Can describe sexual content ({露骨|ろこつ}な{描写|びょうしゃ}, explicit depiction), discrimination, or any behavior that lacks subtlety.
